en: The image shows a black-and-white (or sepia-toned) postcard, featuring a long wooden building with several windows and a slightly gabled entrance section. The building appears to be situated in a semi-rural, possibly northern European environment, with a wooden fence in the background and several other detached houses on a hill. The postcard is mounted on a textured surface, possibly for display or preservation. The top left of the postcard includes text.
